query: Which valuation methods (social cost of carbon, avoided N losses, benefit transfer, market proxies) are most appropriate to monetize ecosystem services at farm and regional scales?

response.query: Which valuation methods (social cost of carbon, avoided N losses, benefit transfer, market proxies) are most appropriate to monetize ecosystem services at farm and regional scales?
response.answer: Benefit transfer and market proxies are most appropriate for monetizing ecosystem services at farm and regional scales. Social cost of carbon and avoided N losses are less directly applicable at these scales.
